physical_blocker_conclusion: No demonstrated native body collision for the combined CAD at the assumed20mm spacer height. Declared straight wire bundles forJ2/J3 intersect the supplied OPI CAD, so those wires must leave outward before rising; this is a routing condition, not proof of a real selected cable collision. J10 cooler-side wire route remains conditional on the unprovided cooler lateral shape.
